name: suffocating-miasma-declined-debuff-deals-two-unpreventable-damage
notes: Suffocating Miasma: at the start of player 2's recollection phase (their second turn - each player's first recollection is skipped) player 2 declines to put a debuff counter on their ally. The decline used to skip SuffocatingMiasmaRecollection, so the 'if they don't, deal 2 unpreventable damage' branch never ran.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Suffocating Miasma's optional-choice continuation (SuffocatingMiasmaRecollection) was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the prompt (PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods skip the handler and its "if you don't" branch never ran: the 2 unpreventable damage to the champion was never dealt. Fix: the queue site passes dontSkipOnPass and the handler consumes the decline with ConsumeDeclinedChoice().
